question: Should Crabbox prioritize a generic Station-backed external-harness HTTP/SSE bridge now, or keep the merged bridge document as a future contract until the Station lifecycle and security model are implemented?
rationale: The requested capability adds a durable runtime mode, public bridge contract, credential boundary, provider-support policy, and harness integration posture; source and roadmap evidence do not establish a mechanical implementation choice.

options.title: Stage it through Station first
options.body: Implement the durable Station lifecycle and its no-model-credential security baseline first, then add the external harness bridge as a narrowly scoped phase.

options.title: Accept a bridge-only phase
options.body: Sponsor a limited loopback daemon bridge for one supported provider, with scoped tickets and no model credentials, before broader Station lifecycle work.

options.title: Defer core support
options.body: Keep the contract documentation only and direct experiments to provider or external integration layers until demand and security ownership are clearer.

recommendation.title: Stage it through Station first
recommendation.body: Implement the durable Station lifecycle and its no-model-credential security baseline first, then add the external harness bridge as a narrowly scoped phase.

likelyOwner.reason: The open Station roadmap authored by zozo123 owns the lifecycle and credential design choices that determine whether this bridge should become a core capability.
